correctness.rationale: All 65,536 vertex subsets are exhaustively tested, yielding 2143 augmented faces; the 1065 ordinary Morse pairs are certified acyclic by a topological sort of every one of 9280 incidences. The exact integral 5×6 degree-four boundary has a determinant -1 minor, hence the 3-skeleton wedge of five 3-spheres admits five primitive 3/4-cell cancellations to S4. Independent full mod-2 boundary ranks give reduced H4=F2. Signed Lefschetz computation on genuine full-group generators gives translation degree +1 and S5 transposition degree -1, establishing integral sign character. Not merely an observed homology rank.

value.rationale: The unique strongly regular 16-vertex triangle-free Clebsch graph is a canonical first nontrivial projective-cube/folded-five-cube benchmark for 2-independence/dissociation topology. An unexpectedly nonpure seven-dimensional complex is proved to be a single four-sphere, and the full 1920-element symmetry action on its integral top homology is determined. These supply an exact structural datum for understanding higher-independence filtrations and symmetry, not an arbitrary numerical slice. No unjustified general-family consequence is claimed.
